mods.name: Pikachu
mods.description: Pikachu joins the adventure with Thunderbolt.

mods.name: Retry
mods.description: Requires OpenBonk 0.1.11 or newer. Revive in place and continue the same run.

mods.name: Unlock Everything
mods.description: Temporarily unlock content without changing your saved progress. Requires OpenBonk 0.1.4 or newer.

mods.name: Instant Collect
mods.description: Automatically collect newly spawned XP. Requires OpenBonk 0.1.4 or newer.

mods.name: Lucky Tome
mods.description: Start with a level 99 Luck tome. Requires OpenBonk 0.1.5 or newer.

mods.name: Auto Pots
mods.description: Open nearby pots automatically while playing. Requires OpenBonk 0.1.5 or newer.

mods.name: Item Lab
mods.description: Search and add items from the pause menu; can affect progress. Requires OpenBonk 0.1.5 or newer.

mods.name: Chest Tracker
mods.description: Show unopened and total chests; shrine and vendor tracking not included. Requires OpenBonk 0.1.7 or newer.

mods.name: Minimap Zoom
mods.description: Increase minimap coverage; a focused Better Minimap adaptation. Requires OpenBonk 0.1.7 or newer.

mods.name: Toggle Everything
mods.description: Allow the Toggler to control weapons, tomes and items. Requires OpenBonk 0.1.7 or newer.

mods.name: Run Metrics
mods.description: Show XP and gold rates and effective weapon DPS. Requires OpenBonk 0.1.8 or newer.

mods.name: Distrito Nimbo
mods.description: Rooftop city map with three districts, colored Pokémon mobs and bosses, ball capsules, textured rooftops and a sunny sky. Requires OpenBonk 0.1.14 or newer; contains third-party Pokémon models.

mods.name: Offer Tools
mods.description: Reusable refreshes, skips and banishes with normal gold costs. Partial SimpleModMenu adaptation; requires OpenBonk 0.1.9 or newer.
